financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwriters' exercise of option to purchase 148,258 additional shares (gross $1.8M less $0.1M issuance costs). The filing gives only 'July 2025', so the day is a placeholder.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In July 2025 the underwriters of the Offering exercised the Option and purchased 148,258 shares of common stock for gross proceeds of $1.8 million and incurred issuance costs of $0.1 million.

warrants.quote: as of June 30, 2025 pre-funded warrants to purchase an aggregate of 5,368,508 shares of common stock were outstanding.
